s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of systemic illness with mental status changes, abdominal symptoms, respiratory distress, and cardiovascular instability
salient_findings: Hypoxia with SpO₂ of 88% on room air
key_facts: 64-year-old man
Medical history of dyslipidemia, diabetes mellitus, hypertension, peripheral artery disease, and coronary artery disease
Previous percutaneous coronary intervention to the left anterior descending and right coronary artery
Leukocyte count of 13.4 × 10⁹/L
Sodium level of 129 mmol/L
Elevated high-sensitivity troponin of 102 μg/L
Elevated N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide of 1098 ng/L
Positive Legionella pneumophila serogroup 1 antigen in urine
Negative SARS-CoV-2 and influenza tests
Chest radiograph showing right-sided lung infiltrates

ECG findings of sinus tachycardia, old incomplete right bundle branch block, new left posterior fascicular block, multifocal PVCs, atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response, and fascicular ventricular tachycardia
